def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The 4-valued cross divides the grid into repeated tiles; copy the
    # top-left tile into each region, leaving divider rows/columns intact.
    sep_r = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 4 for v in row)), None)
    sep_c = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 4 for r in range(h))), None)
    if sep_r is None or sep_c is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    tile = [row[:sep_c] for row in grid[:sep_r]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        if r == sep_r:
            continue
        for c in range(w):
            if c == sep_c:
                continue
            out[r][c] = tile[r % sep_r][c % sep_c]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    # Dividers are uniform full lines of a non-background color; detect the
    # crossing separators by line length and repeated values.
    sep_r = next((r for r in sep_rows if h > 1 and len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    sep_c = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if sep_r is None or sep_c is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    divider = grid[sep_r][sep_c]
    counts = {}
    for r in range(h):
        if r == sep_r: continue
        for c in range(w):
            if c == sep_c: continue
            v = grid[r][c]
            if v != divider: counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get) if counts else divider
    # The non-background tile is the source; replicate its pattern through
    # the repeated tile layout on both sides of the cross.
    row_ranges = [(0, sep_r), (sep_r + 1, h)]
    col_ranges = [(0, sep_c), (sep_c + 1, w)]
    best = None
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_ranges):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_ranges):
            n = sum(grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != divider
                    for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            if best is None or n > best[0]: best = (n, ri, ci)
    _, bri, bci = best
    br0, br1 = row_ranges[bri]; bc0, bc1 = col_ranges[bci]
    tile = [row[bc0:bc1] for row in grid[br0:br1]]
    th, tw = br1 - br0, bc1 - bc0
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        if r == sep_r: continue
        for c in range(w):
            if c == sep_c: continue
            out[r][c] = tile[(r - br0) % th][(c - bc0) % tw]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A full uniform line marks a separator. Find the color most often used
    # on such lines, then use all such rows/columns as tile boundaries.
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep_counts = {}
    for r in row_lines: sep_counts[grid[r][0]] = sep_counts.get(grid[r][0], 0) + 1
    for c in col_lines: sep_counts[grid[0][c]] = sep_counts.get(grid[0][c], 0) + 1
    if not sep_counts:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    divider = max(sep_counts, key=sep_counts.get)
    row_seps = [r for r in row_lines if grid[r][0] == divider]
    col_seps = [c for c in col_lines if grid[0][c] == divider]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    regions = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            if r0 < r1 and c0 < c1:
                regions.append((r0,r1,c0,c1))
    # Background is the most common non-divider color; source tile has
    # the greatest number of non-background cells.
    from collections import Counter
    freq = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != divider)
    if not freq:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(freq, key=freq.get)
    source = max(regions, key=lambda q: sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(q[0],q[1]) for c in range(q[2],q[3])))
    sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1 = source
    tile = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    th, tw = len(tile), len(tile[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in regions:
        for r in range(r0,r1):
            for c in range(c0,c1):
                out[r][c] = tile[(r-r0) % th][(c-c0) % tw]
    return out
PY

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_seps = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    # Ignore accidental uniform lines unless they are the repeated divider color.
    line_colors = Counter([grid[r][0] for r in row_seps] + [grid[0][c] for c in col_seps])
    if not line_colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    divider = line_colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_seps = [r for r in row_seps if grid[r][0] == divider]
    col_seps = [c for c in col_seps if grid[0][c] == divider]
    rb, cb = [-1] + row_seps + [h], [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    regions = [(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1], cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])
               for i in range(len(rb)-1) for j in range(len(cb)-1)
               if rb[i]+1 < rb[i+1] and cb[j]+1 < cb[j+1]]
    if not regions:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The panel holding the pattern is the panel with the most non-background cells.
    src = max(regions, key=lambda q: sum(grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != divider
                                         for r in range(q[0],q[1]) for c in range(q[2],q[3])))
    r0,r1,c0,c1 = src
    tile = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    th,tw = r1-r0,c1-c0
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,x,y in regions:
        for r in range(a,b):
            for c in range(x,y):
                out[r][c] = tile[(r-a)%th][(c-x)%tw]
    return out
